header: THE SWITCH of the search bar's "Looks like a name" hint (src/lib/search/nameHint/nameHint.ts). I keep it in one place so I can try the two sources one at a time: "both" the built-in Indian names AND the plant's own name words (the default) "builtin" only the built-in list: no word list is fetched from the server at all "plant" only the plant's name words (fetched once when the search bar opens) "off" no hint Change the value, save, and the page reloads with it. This is a plain constant with no imports, because the screen reads it.
